title: 2 Consumer Staples Stocks Giving Investors a Break From the AI Trade
excerpt: Coca-Cola and Hershey posted strong Q2 2026 earnings and offer dividend growth track records, making them notable consumer staples picks amid renewed interes...
content_html:
Key Points

  • Interested in Hershey Company (The)? Here are five stocks we like better.

  • Investors seeking alternatives to the AI trade may consider consumer staples like Coca-Cola and Hershey, which offer dividends and relative value.

  • Coca-Cola posted strong second-quarter results driven by its FIFA World Cup marketing campaign, though investors question whether the growth boost will prove durable.

  • Hershey's second-quarter earnings beat expectations, fueled by robust salty snacks growth and lower cocoa prices, while both companies maintain strong dividend growth track records.

Heading into 2026, many investors were looking for alternatives to the artificial intelligence (AI) trade. The problem has been that many diversified approaches that are performing well (e.g., emerging markets or small-cap stocks) lead back to tech.

One option for true sector rotation would be to invest in consumer staples. The Consumer Staples Select Sector SPDR Fund (NYSEARCA: XLP) is up about 10% year-to-date. That's lower than the broader market, but it may also indicate that the broader rotation has further to go.

→ Popular's Earnings Beat Shows Why This Bank Stock Keeps Climbing

Aside from the potential upside in stock prices, there's another reason to reconsider consumer staples stocks. Many investors have been moving toward safety, which is igniting interest in dividend stocks.

Two stocks that meet that profile have moved in different directions year-to-date. The Coca-Cola Company (NYSE: KO) is up roughly 26% in 2026. On the other hand, The Hershey Company (NYSE: HSY) is down about 3% in 2026.

→ SpaceX's First Earnings Report Could Decide Whether Shorts or Bulls Have Control

Neither stock is particularly cheap based on valuation. But they're a bargain compared to many stocks in the artificial intelligence (AI) trade. Plus, as we head into the back half of the year, there are reasons beyond a dividend to buy each stock.

Coca-Cola's World Cup Bet Is Paying Off—But Will It Stick?

Coca-Cola's second-quarter results show the World Cup activation working as intended. Net revenues grew 7% to $13.4 billion, and organic revenues climbed 6%, with unit case volume up 5%. Earnings per share (EPS) jumped 16% to $1.03, while comparable EPS grew 11% to 97 cents.

→ Financials Hit Record Highs as the AI Trade Unravels—Can They Keep Leading?

The volume numbers in the earnings report clearly showed that the company's FIFA World Cup campaign wasn't a frivolous marketing spend. The trademark Coca-Cola brand grew 5%, and Powerade grew 8%, with the company crediting the tournament's more than 60 billion digital impressions and connected-packaging engagement with over 80 million consumers for a meaningful share of that growth.

content_html_zh:
要点

  • 对好时公司感兴趣？ 这是我们更喜欢的五只股票。
  • 寻求人工智能行业替代品的投资者可能会考虑可口可乐和好时等消费必需品，它们提供股息和相对价值。
  • 可口可乐在国际足联世界杯营销活动的推动下公布了强劲的第二季度业绩，尽管投资者质疑这种增长动力能否持久。
  • 受咸味零食强劲增长和可可价格下跌的推动，好时第二季度收益超出预期，同时两家公司都保持强劲的股息增长记录。

进入 2026 年，许多投资者都在寻找人工智能 (AI) 行业的替代品。 问题在于，许多表现良好的多元化投资方法（例如新兴市场或小盘股）都会回归科技股。

真正的行业轮动的一种选择是投资消费必需品。 消费必需品精选行业 SPDR 基金（NYSEARCA：XLP）今年迄今已上涨约 10%。 这低于大盘，但这也可能表明更广泛的轮动还有进一步的发展。

→ 大众公司的盈利表现说明了该银行股票为何持续上涨

除了股价的潜在上涨之外，还有另一个原因需要重新考虑消费必需品股票。 许多投资者已经转向安全型，这引发了对股息股票的兴趣。

今年迄今为止，两只符合这一特征的股票已朝着不同的方向发展。 可口可乐公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：KO）2026 年股价上涨约 26%。 另一方面，好时公司（NYSE：HSY）2026 年股价下跌约 3%。

→ SpaceX 的第一份收益报告可能决定空头还是多头拥有控制权

从估值来看，这两只股票都不是特别便宜。 但与人工智能（AI）行业的许多股票相比，它们的价格很便宜。 另外，当我们进入今年下半年时，除了股息之外，还有其他原因购买每只股票。

可口可乐的世界杯赌注正在获得回报——但它会坚持下去吗？

可口可乐第二季度业绩显示，世界杯活动正在按预期进行。 净收入增长 7%，达到 134 亿美元，有机收入增长 6%，单位销量增长 5%。 每股收益 (EPS) 增长 16% 至 1.03 美元，而可比 EPS 增长 11% 至 97 美分。

→ 随着人工智能贸易的解体，金融股创下历史新高——它们能否继续领先？

收益报告中的数量数字清楚地表明，该公司的国际足联世界杯活动并非无意义的营销支出。 可口可乐品牌增长了 5%，Powerade 增长了 8%，该公司将这一增长的重要份额归功于赛事超过 600 亿次的数字印象以及与超过 8000 万消费者的互联包装互动。
